rule: Every entry is pinned to an exact live branch tip. A disposition is valid only for that exact SHA and must be backed by current-code or repository-history evidence. Missing entries remain unresolved; branch names, age, and inactivity never imply retirement.

The current convergence tree contains the installed laplace-live-substrate command and package contract integration, with active-package/activation-receipt binding and read-only Unicode Tier-0 identity/physicality/S3/Hilbert readback as laplace_app.

Before closing #315, the implementation, regression test, and requirements-gate files from this older branch were verified byte-identical to current main. Replaying the stale branch would only reintroduce old lineage around already-delivered behavior.

This tip adds only branch-specific conventional/GPU probe workflows. It adds no engine, contract, source-profile, persistence, or product implementation. The retained Refactor source-discovery contract/tool/tests own generic read-only corpus inventory; restoring separate branch-triggered probe orchestration would recreate the duplicate CI surface being removed by convergence rather than preserve unique product behavior.

The later merged path owns the same requirement with broader immutable-runtime coverage.

The correct remaining work was measured forward-path cost reduction, not the branch's 120-second serving budget.
